source.migrated_procedure: Fresh SIFT components, pre-geometry whole-track holdout, Essential/PnP, fixed-K sparse BA and reserved-track diagnostics

engineering_changes: All inputs derive from the uploaded video in a fresh run; no previous frames, camera tracks, person masks, fits, Gaussian parameters or optimizer are imported.
Research-global paths and subject lists are replaced with explicit video/root/config/assets parameters.

Earlier engineering default estimated one bounded focal hypothesis from fresh training-track fundamental matrices before fixed-K geometry. It assumes square pixels, zero skew, centered principal point, rectified pixels and a static scene; it is not physical calibration.

An explicit fixed_pinhole profile instead declares K in the exact exported-video image_wh and pixel convention with provenance. Only declared resize is mapped; no sensor crop is guessed and nonzero distortion is rejected.
Pixel-center conversion is explicit: profile and decoded observations use integer centers; training records store principal point plus 0.5 for corner coordinates.
The seed changes from 118 to 119; thresholds and numerical geometry procedure remain frozen. User config may lower the finite point/evaluation/time budgets, never raise them.
Rotation metadata and HDR require a reviewed mapping instead of silent reinterpretation. Source video hashes must remain stable across decoding.

Official pinned YOLO/SAM2/RTMW assets generate new masks and COCO-133 observations. Missing assets or dependencies fail with preserved evidence; there is no synthetic mask or historical cache fallback.
Standalone camera-only output deliberately omits training-inputs/observations and cannot be imported as a complete prepared training run.

Default restored to original fixed factory-crop camera procedure: first supplied 4000x3000 K, uniform resize and centered crop selected from encoded width/height. Landscape and portrait preserve distinct focal lengths and off-axis principal point; no axis swap, new focal estimate, distortion remap, old pose or person state.

controls: Six synthetic views execute real Essential/PnP/BA and all register; held-track identities are absent from solver inputs.
Synthetic focal recovery and held-track exclusion.
Real FFmpeg extraction of a new 12-frame textureless video preserves source indices and rejects unusable geometry without fallback.
Fixed-K pixel-center/resize mapping, HDR/rotation rejection, input budgets and preserved failure directories.

Landscape and portrait full-K projection, off-axis principal point and pixel-center controls; equivalence with the original fixed factory-crop expression; rejection of raw-fisheye and invalid dimensions.

unverified: Physical camera calibration, reviewed physical face correspondences and independent native-image subpixel accuracy.
